components.name: Import Button
components.description: Primary action for loading a graph file.
components.css: .ds-import { display: inline-flex; min-height: 38px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--surface-1); font: 700 12px/1.2 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: border-color .16s ease, color .16s ease; } .ds-import svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-import:hover { border-color: var(--color-text); } .ds-import:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-dim); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-import:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-import:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Quiet Inspector Toggle
components.description: Secondary header action for showing the function inspector.
components.css: .ds-quiet { display: inline-flex; min-height: 38px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 0 13px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--text-soft); font: 600 12px/1.2 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; transition: background .16s ease, border-color .16s ease, color .16s ease; } .ds-quiet:hover { border-color: var(--color-edge); background: var(--color-node); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-quiet:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-dim); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-quiet:active { background: var(--color-border-soft); } .ds-quiet:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Function Search
components.description: Search field at the top of the function navigator.
components.css: .ds-search { display: flex; height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 0 9px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--color-background); color: var(--text-muted); transition: border-color .15s ease, background .15s ease; } .ds-search-label { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip-path: inset(50%); white-space: nowrap; } .ds-search input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; border: 0; outline: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text); font: 400 13px/1.45 var(--font-sans); } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--text-muted); opacity: 1; } .ds-search:focus-within { border-color: var(--text-faint); background: var(--surface-0); } .ds-search input:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Function Navigator Row
components.description: Monospaced function entry in the searchable graph navigator.
components.css: .ds-function { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; gap: 9px; padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: var(--text-soft); text-align: left; font: 400 12px/1.3 var(--font-mono); cursor: pointer; transition: background .14s ease, border-color .14s ease, color .14s ease; } .ds-function:hover { border-color: var(--color-border); background: var(--surface-2); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-function[aria-current="true"] { border-color: var(--color-edge); background: var(--color-border-soft); color: var(--color-text); } .ds-mark { width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: 0 0 7px; border: 1px solid var(--color-accent-dim); border-radius: 2px; background: var(--color-edge); } .ds-function:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-dim); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-function:active { background: var(--color-border-soft); } .ds-function:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .48; }

components.name: Inspector Section
components.description: Expandable detail region for a summary, connections, or code.
components.html:
Function summary
Follows the actual function data.
components.css: .ds-section { overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 7px; background: var(--surface-1); color: var(--text-soft); } .ds-section summary { display: flex; min-height: 37px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 0 11px; color: var(--text-soft); font: 650 12px/1.3 var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; } .ds-section summary:hover { color: var(--color-text); } .ds-section summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-accent-dim); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-section-body { padding: 0 11px 11px; color: var(--text-soft); font: 400 12px/1.55 var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Connection Chip
components.description: Compact monospaced link to a caller or callee.
components.css: .ds-connection { display: inline-block; max-width: 100%; padding: 4px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--color-node); color: var(--color-accent); font: 400 11px/1.35 var(--font-mono); overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview:
The interface is a focused tool for following a binary's real structure. The call graph owns the center; the function navigator and inspector keep search, context, and decompiled output close at hand. Charcoal surfaces make dense labels readable while color carries graph meaning.

Use thin dividers and restrained shadows to separate working regions. Mint marks entry points and active execution, lavender marks imported libraries, and coral marks functions worth inspection. The viewer's runtime palette stays in viewer/styles.css because the backend ships that file with index.html and app.js; tokens.css is a portable reference export only.

Desktop graph nodes measure 176 by 48 pixels with 12-pixel labels. Below 600 pixels they measure 132 by 48 pixels, use a 20-pixel layout padding value, and switch to a top-to-bottom graph. Trace playback hides the graph legend and centers the followed node while retaining a minimum zoom of 1.0 on desktop and 0.85 on narrow screens. Below 1100 pixels, navigator and inspector drawers use dialog semantics and contain keyboard focus until closed.
keyCharacteristics: Tinted charcoal surfaces with fine rules
Color distinguishes entry, import, and interest states

rules.name: The State-Color Rule
rules.body: Keep each graph state legible through its assigned accent: mint for entry and execution, lavender for imports, coral for interest.

dos: Do preserve the mint, lavender, and coral meaning across graph nodes, navigator markers, and trace states.
Do use fine borders and nearby surface tones to separate work areas.
Do keep technical values and decompiled code in Martian Mono.
Do retain the compact desktop columns and switch them to drawers at 1100px.
Do honor reduced-motion preferences for CSS and graph animation.
donts: Don't make entry, import, execution, and interest states share one accent color.
Don't replace the flexible graph canvas with a fixed-width content panel.
Don't introduce heavy shadows to the resting workbench panels.
